about.default_about_text: MedPortal is a leading provider of medical supplies, surgical instruments, and healthcare solutions in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East.
about.default_vision: To be the premier trusted partner in healthcare supply chain, delivering surgical precision and medical excellence to every operating theatre and clinic.
about.default_mission: To equip healthcare professionals with certified, high-grade medical supplies and surgical tools that elevate patient care and clinical outcomes.
about.quality_text: We adhere to the highest international standards. Every product undergoes rigorous testing and quality control before reaching our clients.
about.sfda_text: Fully compliant and registered with the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA), ensuring safety and reliability in all medical supplies.

products.cat_instruments_desc: Precision-crafted instruments built to the highest medical standards. Our range covers everything from basic clamps to specialised surgical tools used across operating theatres worldwide.
products.cat_consumables_desc: Single-use and reusable consumables for every clinical setting — sterile gloves, dressings, syringes, and more, all sourced from SFDA-approved manufacturers.
products.cat_sets_desc: Comprehensive instrument sets packaged and sterilised to procedural standards. Each set is tailored for specific surgical disciplines, saving time and reducing the risk of missing pieces.
